benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Your cost per lead runs high for HVAC
benchmark.body: Healthy HVAC cost per lead on high-intent channels sits at <cite index="7-15">$30–$90</cite>. Google's blended HVAC cost per lead averages <cite index="5-3">$104</cite>. Your $159 Instagram lead is above both.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Late September starts furnace tune-up demand. <cite index="9-11,9-12">Emergency searches face weaker Local Services Ads competition off-hours, so Google Ads picks up the slack</cite>. Position now for heating calls.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="2-19">Top performers use 3 to 5 lead sources</cite>, and <cite index="2-20">HVAC is the slowest-responding trade, with only 11% of businesses replying within an hour</cite>. Speed wins the booking.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: <cite index="6-5">Local Services Ads run $25–$95 per lead</cite> and you only pay for qualified contacts. Worth testing to lower your blended cost per lead.

recommendations.title: Fix the Instagram click-to-site drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 1,055 of 2,795 clicks reached your site this period. Consider tightening the ad-to-landing-page match and testing a shorter form.

recommendations.title: Pivot creative toward furnace tune-ups now
recommendations.detail: Your bio already promotes tune-ups. Consider shifting the Finance ad rotation toward furnace and heating messaging before demand peaks in October.
